name: Qubits Toy Bot
tagline: Assembles looping 3D structures out of Qubits toy pieces
description: The physical construction set gets a working model on the page: its two standard connector shapes are fitted together on screen into closed, looping forms, put up in front of you as they are built. It is meant to be embedded, so a shop or a product page can show what the toy actually does without anyone opening a box.
author: Toy_Maestro
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
